values.note: Midland Fairgrounds 'Seasonal Camping' (general overnight camping, May through October): $30 a night. Dump station $10 per use (drop box at the main gate).

fees.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals ('Camping Cost: $30/night', 'A sanitation station is available for use at the main gate with a fee of $10.00'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals ('Seasonal Camping (May through October weather permitting)'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals ('Most sites have 30 amp electrical services'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals ('Midland Fairgrounds has over 400 campsites', 'Some sites are pull through while others require backing the trailer into the campsite'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals ('modern bathhouses, electrical hookups and shared water sources throughout the campground', 'A sanitation station is available for use at the main gate'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Through the Fair Office: the rentals page's request form ('Seasonal Camping'), info@midlandfair.net or 989-835-7901. Site availability varies with events held at the fairgrounds. One family unit per site; the renter must be 18+ and present.

booking.source: https://www.midlandfair.com/rentals (request form, 'site availability will vary based on events being held at the facility', 'call (989) 835-7901') + the fair's camper information PDF ('Please contact the Fair Office at 989-835-7901 for availability of camping depending on events'), read 2026-10-22

note: Midland County fairgrounds campground at 6905 Eastman Ave, off US-10 exit 122; drive-in, pull-through and back-in sites, big rigs OK. Site availability varies with events at the fairgrounds. --Claude
summary: Fair's rentals page confirms general overnight camping May-October at $30/night, 400+ sites (most 30 A), shared water, modern bathhouses, pull-through and back-in sites, a $10 dump station, booking through the Fair Office (989-835-7901). Added season dates. Note trimmed of price/season/hookup/booking text.
